title: Logo audit — step 1 "make it pop"
summary: Audit of the current Beyond House Cleaning logo's palette, geometry, and design flaws with recommendations for an SVG rebuild and lockup family.
notes: Prose audit with findings/recommendations tables (palette hex values, geometry measurements, variant list); no Status/Accepted field, no user stories, no API/schema contract, so classified DOC over SPEC despite the tabular measurement data. Recommendations are proposed next steps, not locked decisions, so not ADR.
